about_the_game:
Command Reboot is a brain-burning journey that uses programming to pry the fate of the stars!

【Core Experience】

  In the vastness of deep space outlined by retro pixels, you will play as an intergalactic engineer, commanding intelligent robots to move forward with lines of precise programmes! Each string of commands will break out of a thrilling space crisis, and each logic flaw could trigger a robot's fall!

[Three Fatal Attractions]

★ Epic space adventure exploration plot: the space ship is in distress during the interstellar voyage, leaving behind all kinds of difficulties as well as puzzles, which require the interstellar engineers to command the intelligent robots step by step by commands to break out in the space crisis. The programme you enter will be the light of hope to save the spacecraft.

★ Brain rollercoaster mechanism: from basic instructions to complex procedures, from a single mechanism to a complex combination of mechanisms, so that each crack to add challenge, exercise the meticulousness of the engineer's thinking, logic, so that engineers have something to look forward to the next level.

★ Experience Programmer's Delight: Watch the chain of instructions entered by hand trigger perfectly like dominoes, and the intelligent robots follow your instructions to gracefully execute the operations - this may be a more uptempo moment than passing the level!

Are you ready for the most hardcore and adventurous adventure in the universe?
